Strat & Ops — Abi & Mateo
Monitor and replenish snacks and catering throughout the day
Manage swag — correct labeled tier box, track daily quantities, no replenishment until next day
Keep booth tidy — surfaces, displays, pamphlets
Ensure all 4 screens are running and content is looping
Run the activation game; distribute prizes from the correct tier box
Greet and direct walk-ins not yet engaged with a researcher
First contact for any logistics issue — reach Abi or Mateo on WhatsApp
Setup each morning, teardown each evening
Manage meeting room and storage room access
Researchers
Engage attendees — talk about your work, Layer 6's research, and our ICML papers
After a genuine conversation, hand the attendee a green coin — their entry to the activation game
If someone asks about jobs, point to the Layer 6 listing on the ICML portal. Show the pamphlet or TV screens
Invite attendees to the after-party — Sat Jul 11, 7–11 PM
If overwhelmed, redirect overflow to another available researcher
Wear the Layer 6 quarter-zip and lanyard at all times on shift
Take photos — talks, after-party, booth moments. Upload to the shared Google Photos album
Storage room — bag drop. Meeting room — private conversations or interviews if free
Talent Acquisition — Ron
Present all shifts across all 3 days
Handle all career and talent conversations at the booth
Direct candidates to the Layer 6 listing on the ICML job portal to submit their CV

The Gate
Attendees must speak with a researcher first. After a real conversation, the researcher hands them a green coin. No coin, no play.
The Game — Dice Roll
🎲 Dice Roll
Roll two 6s🥇 Premium
Roll one 6🥈 Mid-Tier
No 6s🥉 Common
Daily Prize Quantities
🥉 Tier 1 — Common
~150 per day · everyone who plays
Box labeled TIER 1.
🥈 Tier 2 — Mid-Tier
~75 per day · give sparingly
Box labeled TIER 2.
🥇 Tier 3 — Premium
~25 per day · these will run out
Box labeled TIER 3.
No mid-day replenishment. When a tier runs out, it's done for the day. Tell them to come back tomorrow.
We're building a talent pipeline, not filling specific roles. Genuine connection is the goal.
If Someone Asks About Jobs
Point to the Layer 6 listing on the ICML job portal — website or ICML app
Show the pamphlet for role details, or direct to the TV screens
CV submissions go through the ICML portal job listing
For escalation, contact Abi or Mateo on WhatsApp
What Not to Say
Don't promise specific roles, timelines, or hiring outcomes
Don't comment on compensation
International hiring is TBD — don't confirm or deny

About Layer 6
Layer 6 is TD Bank Group's AI research centre of excellence. We work on the hardest ML problems at one of North America's largest banks — with the culture of a startup and the resources of a top-tier financial institution.

Papers at ICML 2026

Main Conference Papers
Research Pillars
Tabular Foundation Models
Foundation models purpose-built for structured, tabular data — the dominant data type in financial services.
Generative and Agentic AI
Advancing generative models and autonomous agents that operate reliably at enterprise scale.
Trustworthy AI
Fairness, privacy, and robustness — AI systems people can trust in high-stakes environments.
Engineering and Optimization
Systems and methods that bring research to production at scale.
Published In
ICMLNeurIPSICLRCVPRACL

Getting from the Airport
Incheon International Airport (ICN) is the main arrival airport. COEX is in Gangnam — about 60–90 min away.
AREX + SubwayBest value. AREX to Seoul Station (~43 min), then Line 2 to Samseong → 5 min walk to COEX. Total ~70 min.
Limousine BusRoute 6001/6002 to Gangnam. ~60–80 min. Cheaper than taxi.
Taxi / Kakao TMost convenient with luggage. ~60–90 min, ₩70,000–90,000 KRW.
From COEXSamseong Station (Line 2) connects directly to COEX underground.

Data before you land. Activate here →
☀️
Weather in July
Hot and humid, 28–33°C. Rainy season. Pack light clothes, portable umbrella.
🔌
Power Adapter
Type C/F outlets, 220V. Bring a universal adapter.
Getting Around
🚇
T-money Card
Tap-to-pay for all Seoul metro and buses. Buy at any convenience store or airport.
🚕
Kakao Taxi
Download the Kakao T app. Korea's Uber — reliable, English-friendly.
💳
Cash & Cards
Cards widely accepted. Good to have some KRW for markets.
Culture
🙏
No Tipping
Not customary in Korea — restaurants, taxis, or cafes.
🏪
Convenience Stores
GS25, CU, 7-Eleven everywhere — great for meals, snacks, drinks.
💬
Korean Phrases
Thank you: 감사합니다 gam-sa-ham-ni-da
Excuse me: 실례합니다 sil-lye-ham-ni-da
Bathroom?: 화장실이 어디예요? hwa-jang-sil-i eo-di-ye-yo?
How much?: 얼마예요? eol-ma-ye-yo?
Hello: 안녕하세요 an-nyeong-ha-se-yo
Delicious!: 맛있어요! ma-si-sseo-yo!

Pick up your badge at the Registration Check-in Desk at the main entrance before entering. $60 lost badge fee. Do not let anyone use your badge.

Swag and catering are for attendees, not personal use
All communications representing Layer 6 or TD should stay on-message — redirect sensitive questions to Abi or Mateo
Social media posts from the booth should be tasteful and professional
